## SPOROTRICHOSIS
Sporotrichosis occurs most often in people who have had significant outdoor
exposure to soil. In immunocompetent people, disease is usually limited to the
skin. In people with decreased host defenses (eg, HIV/AIDS, alcoholism,
diabetes mellitus, or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) sporotrichosis
often disseminates to bones, joints, or lungs. Consult Infectious Diseases or
Dermatology
## ____________________________________________________________________________
## Cutaneous infection in a patient without HIV infection
## ____________________________________________________________________________
[Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h continue for 2-4 weeks after all lesions](psjzid-itraconazole-200mg-po-q12h)
resolved, usually for a total of 3-6 months ($) [DI]
## Alternative
Consult Dermatology or Infectious Diseases.
## ____________________________________________________________________________
## Extracutaneous infection or any infection in a patient with HIV/AIDS
## ____________________________________________________________________________
Consult Dermatology or Infectious Diseases.
